name: SARSILMAZ SAR9 GEN3 BLACK 9x19mm Semi Automatic Pistol
lead: The newest and most technologically advanced generation of the SAR9 series, the GEN3 offers users a brand new experience with its design and engineering features.
description: The innovative design that shapes the third-generation SAR9 models brings together Sarsılmaz's expertise in polymer frames, stainless cassettes, high-alloy steel barrels, and slides at the most advanced level. The SAR9 GEN3 also offers a wide range of customization options with interchangeable grip panels and backstraps, manual safety, and a Picatinny rail that perfectly adapts to all kinds of accessories. The third-generation SAR9 takes safety to the next level with its trigger safety, striker-fired system, and frame safety features. The 18-degree grip angle and slide with enhanced grip serrations, which provide superior control, are among the features of the SAR9 GEN3 that ensure the most comfortable use even in challenging conditions. Combining durability and precision, the SAR9 GEN3 makes aiming easier than ever thanks to its 90-degree trigger break, short reset trigger, and enhanced trigger sensitivity. Wider and more numerous cooling cuts, developed to ensure maximum performance in successive shots, enable barrel cooling from different angles. The SAR9 GEN3 enhances the red dot ready option with compatible co-witness sights.

parameters: 3 Different Size S-M-L Changeable Back Straps And Side Plates
